title: Create: Autocrafting
description: Create:autocrafting adds a whole new function to the stock ticker, autocrafting!
body:
# Create: Autocrafting

Welcome to Create: Autocrafting, an addon that allows you to create a entire autocrafting system, allowing you to simply request an item, and it will be crafted, automatically, with recipe trees put into consideration

# Requirements

- Minecraft ‹1.20.1›
- Create ‹6.0.8› or higher
